entities.name: Methyl 3-(2-hydroxyphenyl)propanoate
observations: Phenolic ester substrate; its phenolic oxygen is deprotonated to form the nucleophile in the proposed O-benzylation.

entities.name: Bis(chloromethyl)benzene
observations: Benzylic dihalide electrophile represented as ClCH2–C6H4–CH2Cl; one chloromethyl group undergoes substitution while the other is retained.

entities.name: Selective phenolic O-benzylation
observations: Williamson ether synthesis: phenoxide performs SN2 displacement at one benzylic chloromethyl group to form an aryl benzyl ether.
The product retains the second chloromethyl group, indicating mono-substitution of the bis(chloromethyl)benzene.

entities.name: K2CO3 in acetonitrile
observations: Most plausible first-choice condition set for selective phenolic O-benzylation with a benzylic chloride; carbonate generates phenoxide under nucleophilic substitution conditions.

entities.name: Cs2CO3 in DMF
observations: Plausible alternative condition set when stronger or more soluble carbonate-base conditions are desired for phenoxide formation.

entities.name: NaH in DMF
observations: Stronger-base alternative for generating the phenoxide; requires moisture exclusion and careful stoichiometric control.
